title: mst-direct: Matching for Structural Transport — reproducibility package
description:
Source code, experiment scripts, frozen synthetic data, seeds and reference results for the article Matching for Structural Transport: preserving complete multivariate tuples in conditional geostatistical simulation (submitted to Computers & Geosciences). Matching for Structural Transport (MST) simulates multivariate fields by assigning complete multivariate tuples to the positions of a conditioned Gaussian reference field (FFT-MA with cokriging) through entropy-regularized optimal transport (Sinkhorn) followed by a bijective rounding, so the empirical joint distribution of the pool is preserved exactly and complete conditioning data are honoured.

The package regenerates the synthetic benchmark (MST, Gaussian copula with FFT-MA, sequential Gaussian simulation and PPMT/pymgt), the Jura cadmium validation (nested spatial validation, historical split and reference-field ablation), the interval-calibration experiment and the figures. Run python run_all.py quick for a 3-minute check. The Jura data are downloaded from the R package gstat by data/fetch_jura.py. Code: MIT; data and results: CC BY 4.0.
notes: Associated article submitted to Computers & Geosciences; update related_identifiers with 'isSupplementTo' and the article DOI after publication.
